pluginManager.title: Plugins
pluginManager.infoDescription: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
pluginManager.error: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
pluginManager.unavailable: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
pluginManager.restartNotice: The change takes effect at the next start
pluginManager.overriddenNotice: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
pluginManager.partsEmpty: This plugin pack contains no components.
pluginManager.installDescription: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
pluginManager.installGuideIdTitle: Enter the plugin's npm package name
pluginManager.installGuideIdHint: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
pluginManager.installGitTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
pluginManager.installPathTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
pluginManager.installGuideSafety: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
pluginManager.installUpgradeNotice: Installed plugins do not update automatically yet. To upgrade a plugin, uninstall it and install the new version. Later releases will keep improving the upgrade experience.
pluginManager.registryLegend: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
pluginManager.registryCustomHint: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
pluginManager.registryCustomInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
pluginManager.installProblemInvalid: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
pluginManager.installProblemInstalled: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
pluginManager.installProblemShipped: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
pluginManager.installProblemNotPackage: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
pluginManager.installProblemNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
pluginManager.installProblemNetwork: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
pluginManager.installProblemNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
pluginManager.installProblemUnknown: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}
pluginManager.installFailedTitle: The plugin could not be installed
pluginManager.installCancelAndEdit: Cancel installation and return to editing
pluginManager.installApplyingCancellationError: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
pluginManager.installUnknownDescription: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
pluginManager.installResultUnconfirmed: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
pluginManager.installAwaitingAcceptance: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
pluginManager.installBackgroundUnknown: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
pluginManager.installBackgroundUnconfirmed: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
pluginManager.installBackgroundApplying: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
pluginManager.installCancelled: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
pluginManager.installCancelUnconfirmed: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
pluginManager.installAttempt: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
pluginManager.installFailureNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
pluginManager.installFailureNetworkHost: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
pluginManager.installFailureDiskFull: The disk is full; the install stopped
pluginManager.installFailurePermission: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
pluginManager.installFailureBuildBlocked: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
pluginManager.installFailureBuildBlockedManual: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
pluginManager.installFailureIntegrity: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
pluginManager.installFailurePnpmMissing: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
pluginManager.installFailureGeneric: Something went wrong during the install; the details say what
pluginManager.installDoneNothing: Install finished with no new dependency.
pluginManager.installDoneRestart: Installed; it loads at the next start.
pluginManager.installApprovalDescription: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
pluginManager.installApprovalConsequence: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
pluginManager.confirmUninstallDescription: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
pluginManager.reasonManagementRequired: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
pluginManager.reasonUnaddressable: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
pluginManager.reasonInvalidSpec: Enter a valid package name or address.
pluginManager.reasonAmbiguousInstall: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
pluginManager.reasonNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
pluginManager.reasonNotRemovable: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
pluginManager.reasonStopProfile: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
pluginManager.reasonBundleInUse: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
pluginManager.reasonStaleApproval: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
pluginManager.reasonIncompatibleVersion: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {peers}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
pluginManager.reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
pluginManager.reasonIncompatibleInstall: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
pluginManager.reasonIncompatibleInstalled: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
